answer: Municipal crews once filed 50 flood-wall payouts from one drone still of the same span. A payout now posts only after the inspector crawls the documented hollow of pier 4 under the midspan bridge, records a 16-minute pressure series at tidal nadir from a 2.3 kg logger bolted to row 11, and files an 18-bin hydrostatic hash plus a 42-second film of the 1.4 m air gap. Re-measurement must stay within 0.04 m of the filed low-water mark and 0.9 kPa of the logger peak. If the logger serial recurs or the camera never leaves the van, a 220-coin bond is cut 45% and the key is barred for 6 epochs.
